_note: Authored opening sentences for the description sweep (#1404), batch 09.

proposals.current: Creates an annotation for each path based on its name or its full path.
proposals.proposed: Derives an annotation from each file or directory path, based on its name or its full path.

proposals.current: Takes each input folder and outputs the files it contains, optionally from a named subfolder and, if enabled, from all subfolders. A filter expression can keep only matching files, and recursive search can follow symbolic links.
proposals.proposed: Lists the files inside each input folder and outputs the files it contains, optionally from a named subfolder and, if enabled, from all subfolders. A filter expression can keep only matching files, and recursive search can follow symbolic links.

proposals.current: Annotates files or directories with their properties
proposals.proposed: Annotates each path with its properties, such as name, parent, size, type and last modification time, and passes the files or directories on unchanged.

proposals.current: Obtains the output path of the current run where the receiving data is stored.
proposals.proposed: Get the output path of the current run: obtains the output path of the current run where the receiving data is stored.

proposals.current: Collects all incoming data into one or multiple folders that contain the raw output files. The output files are named according to the metadata columns and can be easily processed by humans or third-party scripts. The output of this algorithm is the selected output directory. Please note that you do not need to explicitly export data, as JIPipe automatically saves all output data.
proposals.proposed: The old version of the data export collects all incoming data into one or multiple folders that contain the raw output files. The output files are named according to the metadata columns and can be easily processed by humans or third-party scripts. The output is the selected output directory. You do not need to explicitly export data, as JIPipe automatically saves all output data.

proposals.current: Exports all incoming data as data table directory. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of multiple data items. If you want to group all data into one output, set the matching strategy to 'Custom' and leave 'Data set matching annotations' empty.
proposals.proposed: Exports all incoming data as a data table directory of output paths, taking the data from the path input. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of multiple data items. If you want to group all data into one output, set the matching strategy to 'Custom' and leave 'Data set matching annotations' empty.

proposals.current: Creates an annotation for each path based on its name
proposals.proposed: Turns folders into annotations: creates an annotation for each folder path based on its name.

proposals.current: Generates an export path for the input data and returns it as JIPipe path data
proposals.proposed: Get the export path: generates an export path for the input data and returns it as path data.

proposals.current: Concatenates the input paths by a string.
proposals.proposed: Concatenates each input path with a string parameter, so a fixed suffix, prefix or folder can be appended.

proposals.current: Extracts the parent folder of each path
proposals.proposed: Get the parent directory: extracts the parent directory of each path.

proposals.current: Processes each incoming path with an expression
proposals.proposed: Modify each incoming path via a user-written expression, for example to rewrite it in a custom way.

proposals.current: Converts the child path into a path relative to the parent path. This also works for children that are located in a parent folder. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.
proposals.proposed: Relativize paths by converting the child path into a path relative to the parent path. This also works for children that are located in a parent folder. Incoming data is grouped based on the annotations, one data item per slot.

proposals.current: Modifies the incoming paths so that they are relative to a parent path defined by the parameter. If you leave the parameter empty, the paths are un-changed.
proposals.proposed: Relativize paths to a parent given as a string: modifies the incoming paths so that they are relative to a parent path defined by the parameter. If you leave the parameter empty, the paths are un-changed.

proposals.current: Sets the file or folder name of each path to the specified string.
proposals.proposed: Renames each path by setting the file or folder name of each path to the specified string.

proposals.current: Asks for a path (file/folder) interactively when the node is run. Currently not recommended. Use project user paths instead.
proposals.proposed: Lets you select a path (file or folder) interactively when the node is run. Currently not recommended. Use project user paths instead.
